description: Dimensions of mature embryo (axis length, cotyledon length/width)
notes: No numeric embryo or organ dimensions found in text of the papers read (Bassel 2014, Montenegro-Johnson 2015, Jackson 2017, Cloetens 2006 give scale bars only).

description: Number of integument cell layers that form the seed coat (testa)
conditions: Developmental origin; mature testa = 2 outer (oi1, oi2) + 3 inner (ii1, ii1prime, ii2) integument layers
quote: In Arabidopsis, these integuments consist of five cell layers: three cell layers of inner integuments
notes: Anatomical count. Same description in Demonsais et al. 2020 (Plant J 104:567) and Xu et al. 2017 (JXB). ii1prime and ii2 fuse into the brown pigmented layer; oi2 is the mucilage secretory layer.

description: Thickness of mature dry testa
notes: No numeric Arabidopsis testa thickness found in text of any source read. Only Brassicaceae value seen: pennycress (Thlaspi arvense, much larger seed) XRM thickness mode ~40 um (Griffiths et al. 2025 Sci Rep 15:4532, doi:10.1038/s41598-025-88482-7; not used as a value).

description: Number of endosperm cell layers in mature seed
conditions: Mature seed
quote: the endosperm, a single cell layer of tissue positioned directly underneath the testa
notes: Repeated in Hyvarinen 2025 and Demonsais 2020. Applies to peripheral endosperm; no source read gives a separate layer count for the micropylar endosperm.

description: Thickness of micropylar endosperm (CAP) covering the radicle
notes: Not found for Arabidopsis or Lepidium in any source read. Lepidium CAP puncture-force data exist (Steinbrecher et al. 2025 PCE, figure-only) but no thickness.

description: Structure of seed-coat mucilage released on hydration
conditions: Hydrated mature seed
quote: it is not uniform but is composed of two layers, termed water soluble and adherent
notes: Outer water-soluble layer (unbranched RG I) and inner adherent layer with cellulose in its inner domain (same paper, abstract). Mucilage is released rapidly on imbibition.

description: Thickness/width of hydrated adherent mucilage capsule
notes: Only qualitative width comparisons (mutant vs WT, ruthenium red images) found in Sullivan 2011, Saez-Aguayo et al. 2025 (methods review) and Viudes et al. 2021.

description: Intercellular air-space volume fraction in hypocotyl of dry seed

locator: Results, "3D Images of the Whole Seed"
quote: corresponding volume fractions, to be considered as upper bounds because of the finite spatial resolution, being 1.5 × 10−2
notes: Upper bound. Void network absent from epidermis and provascular tissue; air channels run longitudinally through hypocotyl cortex. Relevant to O2 diffusion/water entry.

description: Intercellular air-space volume fraction in cotyledons of dry seed

locator: Results, "3D Images of the Whole Seed"

Poppy/foxglove meshes in Jackson 2017 Fig. 4 include an 'inner cortex third layer' class; the Arabidopsis key (Fig. 2) has only outer and inner cortex.

description: Hypocotyl epidermal cell number per file (Gendreau et al. 1997)

description: Cells per non-dividing (GL2-expressing) epidermal file, collet to cotyledon base

conditions: Dark-grown seedlings, 24 h post-germination (germination = endosperm rupture), 1/2 MS
quote: Non-dividing files had 17–19 cells starting from the collet
notes: Some (non-GL2) files undergo transverse divisions in the first 24 HPG, so their counts differ. Post-germination count; in the embryo no divisions are expected (Bassel 2014).

description: Cell division during germination sensu stricto (seed to radicle emergence)
conditions: Germination up to endosperm rupture
quote: driven exclusively by cell shape change in the absence of cell division
notes: Bassel cite refs 16-17 for this; allows modelling germination as pure cell expansion on a fixed cell inventory.

description: Time window of first cell-expansion events (lower hypocotyl), concurrent with visible testa rupture

notes: Absolute volume increase; relative growth peaks in radicle/collet (cell ~8).

quote: The mean Ψb of Col‐0 (wild‐type control) was −1.272 MPa

description: SD of base water potential in the population (sigma_psi_b)
